terms.definition: Metals arranged in order of reactivity, based on their reactions with water and acids.
terms.examiner: Potassium, sodium, lithium, calcium, magnesium, (carbon), zinc, iron, (hydrogen), copper.

terms.definition: Gain of oxygen; in terms of electrons, loss of electrons.
terms.examiner: OIL RIG: oxidation is loss, reduction is gain (higher tier).

terms.definition: Loss of oxygen; in terms of electrons, gain of electrons.
terms.examiner: Metals below carbon are extracted by reduction with carbon.

terms.definition: A rock containing enough of a metal compound to make extraction worthwhile.
terms.examiner: Unreactive metals such as gold are found as the metal.

terms.definition: A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from a compound.
terms.examiner: Higher tier: write ionic equations and identify what is oxidised.

terms.definition: An equation showing only the ions and substances that change in a reaction.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. Spectator ions are left out.
